description: This file contains utility functions for managing Kilocode project configurations, including normalization of project IDs, reading configuration files, and retrieving project IDs based on workspace or git repository info.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes a project identifier, extracting repository name from git URLs or returning the ID as-is.

methods.name: getKilocodeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the Kilocode configuration for a workspace, optionally using a git repository URL.

methods.name: getKilocodeConfigFile
methods.description: Reads the Kilocode configuration from the .kilocode/config.json file.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Gets the project ID from configuration file or git repository URL.

methods.name: getWorkspaceProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the project ID for the current VSCode workspace, prioritizing config file over git URL.
